name: A flock of sheep
note: A flock of about a hundred sheep on pasture: wool, mutton, skins and tallow from the same animals. It cannot be researched; the sheep have to be held.
unheld_reason: the society had no sheep, goats or cattle to start with; the founder brings them by trade or an expedition
